note: The second registry version: trials registered after signal-trials.json was frozen. Pre-registered before any setups.db row dated 2026-10-01 or later was read (2026-09-30 is left out: its LGHL setups were looked at while this was designed). Every rule, population, metric, sample and pass line below is fixed; a change means a new trial on new days in a new registry version, never an edit here (backend/tests/test_signal_trials_registry_2.py holds the file to its hash). The reading, multiplicity and peeking rules are signal-trials.json's: each trial is read once when its sample is complete, Holm-adjusted with every trial read the same night. None of them places an order: Nova never buys or sells on Live by itself (Invariant 7, auto_live NO-GO).

trials.name: Room under 2R to the first level of today's map
trials.signal: The first zone of today's level map over the setup's entry sits under 2R of the setup's risk. Today's map is the stock read's level_map intraday zones (the high and low of day, the premarket high, the 09:30 open, VWAP, tops and bottoms tested twice or more, half and whole dollars, yesterday's high, low and close), built from the session's stored one-minute bars closed before the trigger minute; daily levels never count.
trials.rule: Warn on the plan's Room row (operator decision 2026-09-30: keep the 2R target, show the room, warn under 2R, trial first).
trials.population: Triggered setups of the templates in play in setups.db, armed on or after data_from, scored by the scanner (bar_r, gross).
trials.primary_metric: Mean gross bar_r of triggers with Room under 2R minus that of the rest (Room of 2R or more, or no level of today's map over the entry), in R.
trials.test: Cluster bootstrap over symbol-days, 10,000 draws; one-sided.
reported_not_deciding: by the kind of the first level (a half or whole dollar, the high of day, a tested top, VWAP)
trials.on_pass: Room under 2R becomes a NOT A TRADE reason on the plan. It stays a description: nothing places on it.
trials.on_fail: It stays a warning with this result on its hover.

in_sample.evidence: 1,478 harness trades (first pullback, red to green and flat top on five years of minute bars; a 2R bracket over 30 minutes, the stop first on a bar that did both): no level of today's map inside 2R made +0.02R +/-0.10 (n=206) against -0.11R +/-0.04 (n=1,272), a gap within the noise. Capping the target a cent under the first level lowered the mean (-0.097R against -0.087R), so the target stays 2R.
